title: Page 232
transc:
Washington Aug. 12. 1863
Caldwell Head Qrs A. of P.
For Arno If you can conveniently
leave your command I would be
glad to see you at the
Department tomorrow or your earliest convenience
for the purpose of consultation period
Please report whether you can come
and when Arabia Good eve Emerick 


1 AM  Alex Aug 14th 1 AM
For SH Pierce asst Chief
review Trains leave Warrenton Junction at
seven fifteen ten twenty AM
and two twenty five twenty and
eight fifty eight PM on
these we will bring the Shylock
and the number on each train
will be governed somewhat by the
promptitude in unloading the loaded cars
sent from here We will do
our best in getting the Stanhope
to Alex by day light &
I will instruct Mr Stow to
hurry cars as fast as possible
to Rappahannock to connect with the
trains from Warrenton Junction signed Devereux
